themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make municipal information or services easier to access through online systems, public connectivity, service channels, or assistance using those systems.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution, waste, or resource use, expand clean energy, or improve the urban tree canopy rather than create recreational open spaces.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support employment, career transitions, local hiring, entrepreneurship, or the operation of small businesses.

themes.name: Crime Prevention and Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime or improve emergency response through policing, surveillance, safety lighting, or emergency facilities.

themes.name: Public Transport and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve transit service, fare access, rider information, cycling, or safer movement on streets.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Quality
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply, affordability, tenant market transparency, or the quality and efficiency of homes.

themes.name: Healthcare Access and Prevention
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, home-care, specialist, or preventive health services for residents.

themes.name: School Quality and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school facilities, teaching capacity, classroom learning, student meals, or academic and enrichment support.

themes.name: Arts, Culture, and Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals that expand access to arts, cultural events, museums, public art, or neighborhood library services.

themes.name: Neighborhood Green Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that create or improve outdoor neighborhood spaces for gardening, play, recreation, or dog exercise.
